name: Default
shortDescription: Amazon S3-compatible object storage server with a local file backend for data and metadata, protected by a generated access key pair.

alerts.message: There is no web interface. Connect an S3 client to https://<your domain> with path-style addressing and region us-east-1, using the SCALITY_ACCESS_KEY_ID and SCALITY_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY values from the environment.
This image runs on x86_64 servers only.
